name: lark
description: Act as the configured Feishu (Lark) user account. Actions: whoami, list_proxies, doc.read, doc.write (needs doc token or URL), drive.list (optional limit), api (raw call, only if the instance allows it). Writes and deletes are refused unless the proxy instance explicitly allows them.

proxy.description: Proxy instance id. Optional when exactly one proxy is configured.

params.description: Action arguments. doc.read: {doc}. doc.create: {title, content, folder?}. doc.append: {doc, content}. doc.write: {doc, mode:replace|overwrite, pattern?, replacement?, content?}. drive.read: {token, maxRows?}. sheet.read: {token, sheet|sheetId, range?, maxChars?}. sheet.write: {token, sheet|sheetId, range, values}. sheet.info: {token}. drive.list: {folder?, limit?, pageToken?}. api: {method, path, params?, data?}. sheet.write multi: {token, sheet, writes:[{sheet|sheetId, range, values}]}. drive.delete: {files:[{token,type}]|tokens:[...]|token, type?}. doc.blocks: {doc, pageSize?, pageToken?}. im.send: {chatId|userId, text|markdown|image|file|audio|video(+videoCover), idempotencyKey?} to post new, or {replyTo, ...} to answer one message (a reply names no receiver). One content kind per message; media takes an uploaded key (img_/file_), an http(s) URL, or a local path inside fileRoot; audio must be Opus/Ogg, video needs a cover image; returns message_id/chat_id/msg_type. The cli route appends " （由豆包工作发送）" to text/markdown (accepted: the oauth route sends verbatim). drive.upload: {path, folder?, name?}. drive.export: {token, extension, outputDir?, docType?, overwrite?}. drive.read: {token, offset?, limit?, encoding?("auto"|"text"|"base64"), refresh?}; returns content/encoding/next_offset/eof/total_bytes. im.chats: {types?, pageSize?, sort?, pageToken?}. im.messages: {chatId|userId|thread|threadId, start?, end?, order?, pageSize?, pageToken?}; thread reads topic replies from a message id or thread id. im.search: {query, chatId?, sender?, start?, end?, pageSize?, pageToken?}. drive.search: {query?|mine|createdByMe|creatorIds|originalCreatorIds|folderTokens|spaceIds|chatIds|sharerIds|secureLabelIds|onlyTitle|onlyComment, docTypes?, sort?, pageSize?(<=20), pageToken?, createdSince|createdUntil?, openedSince|openedUntil?, editedSince|editedUntil?, commentedSince|commentedUntil?}; times take unix seconds, "YYYY-MM-DD" (midnight +08:00) or relative "7d"/"1m"/"1y", and edit/comment windows snap to the hour; folderTokens and spaceIds are exclusive (doc-only vs wiki-only)}; returns results[{token,title,type,file_type,url,updated_at,cross_tenant}]/has_more/page_token/total. contact.resolve: {query, pageSize?} — a name/email/open_id to {users:[{open_id,name,p2p_chat_id,cross_tenant}]}; calendar.agenda: {from?, to?, calendarId?} — defaults to today, times ISO or YYYY-MM-DD; calendar.create: {summary, start, end, allDay?, attendees?, description?, calendarId?, notify?}; calendar.delete: {eventId, calendarId?, applyTo?, notify?} — high risk, attendee notification on by default.

prompt: Use the lark tool when the task needs the user's own Feishu identity (their documents, their drive, their name). Do not guess a proxy id when several are configured; call list_proxies first.
